correctness.rationale: The spectral-projector integration is exact and respects degeneracies. The unsigned incidence decomposition yields orthogonal signed square-root projectors and the zero block; its original-vertex contribution reduces to half the signless-Laplacian spectral return with a bipartite kernel correction. For K_n both Q eigenspaces and the inserted-edge zero projector are explicitly evaluated. Independent symbolic factoring verifies the all-n difference and strict n>=6 sign. Direct adjacency diagonalizations for n=3..16 and exhaustive 771 connected labeled simple graphs of orders 2..5 corroborate but do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The all-graph return reduction is a structural spectral identity for a natural physical graph operation and provides an exact reusable bridge between quantum observables and the signless Laplacian. The clique family exhibits a genuine, sharp ordering reversal between two symmetry classes at n=6, with degree-two vertices asymptotically trapping nearly all time-averaged return probability. This mathematically motivated complete classification is not a routine parameter substitution or a numerical small-instance census; the mechanism is the extensive zero eigenspace on the edge side.
